mapper.insert: INSERT INTO page_content (page_key, view_type, content, file_id, file_type, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{pageKey}, #{viewType}, #{content}, #{fileId}, #{fileType}, #{updatedBy}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_type = #{viewType}, content = #{content}, file_id = #{fileId}, file_type = #{fileType}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT page_key AS pageKey, view_type AS viewType, content, file_id AS fileId, file_type AS fileType, updated_by AS updatedBy, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM page_content
